Name: RRRR Magnus Portraits in MonoSDE's style (Seasonal Elf or Human Wizard)
Author: MyLadySeven
Description:
[color=#bf9000][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
A personal take on the wizard's portraits for RRRR, editing assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16649]Mono's Portraits 1.6[/url] and from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url], with a touch of elven whimsy ⏾⋆.˚

[color=#bf9000][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url] and their dependencies.
2. Locate "RRRR Wizard in MonoStyle Elf" in your downloads folder.
3. [b]*Please note*[/b] This is a replacement mod. I recommend you save the original assets in case you change your mind and would like to revert back to the previous portraits. 
4. Open "To replace in Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard" folder and replace the assets in Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard. 
5. Open "To replace in RRRR" folder and replace the assets in RRRR.  

For the Human version: No need to replace assets in RRRR, only the portraits in Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard.

[color=#bf9000][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]
This started as a small personal project and ended up being a fun learning journey! I wanted to share in case someone would find themselves in the situation I was in; playing with Mono's Portraits and wanting their RRRR wizard to match. I added a bit of whimsy and made him an elf.

This mod features the 32 expressions portraits for RRRR and all the seasonal outfits from Jello's Vanilla-ish mod, with some characters assets for visual consistency for an elf wizard. [s]If ever someone would prefer a human wizard of my edit, let me know.[/s][u] Human version now available  ⏾⋆.˚ [/u]

[b]**Please note**[/b] As of now, all the outfits are complete. I might take on the different hairstyles later, but for the time being, please consider not using the hairstyles features from Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard as you will encounter visual bugs.

[color=#bf9000][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[b]***This mod is a replacement only***[/b] You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url] for it to function. I would recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16649]Mono's Portraits 1.6[/url] as this mod was intended to match their artstyle!

[color=#bf9000][size=4][b]Changelog[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#efefef][size=3][b]1.1 [/b]-  Facial expressions were improved. Old version still available in archive.[/size][/color]

[color=#bf9000][size=4][b]Credits and Gratitude[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#efefef]This is my first mod, let me know if I forgot something. My original contribution was mainly combining assets from both mods so that they fit together seamlessly. [/color]

[color=#9900ff]The outfits in this mod were mostly taken from Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard's portraits, from which I used the colour palette too.[/color] Thanks you [color=#bf9000]Jellonip[/color] for your wonderful mod. Romancing the wizard was the reason I began to mod my game in the first place. RRRR was everything I hoped for and more! Thank you for your permission!

[color=#9900ff]The body and hairstyle were edited from Mono's Portraits 1.6's assets. The hair colour palette also comes from their mod.[/color] Thanks you [color=#bf9000]MonoSDE[/color] for your original portraits, which enhance my every playthrough. Your artstyle inspired me and I learned a great deal about pixel art based on your mod. Thank you for your permission!

[color=#9900ff]The light effect in the demo images was taken from the Wizard tower lights in SVE, which has open permission.[/color] Thanks to [color=#bf9000]FlashShifter and the team behind SVE[/color] for all the content their mod adds in general.

Thanks to [color=#bf9000]ConcernedApe[/color] for Stardew Valley.

Thank [color=#bf9000]you[/color] for reading all this. ⏾⋆.˚
